courses.title: Advanced Doppler Weather Radar (DWR) Calibration & Operational Nowcasting
courses.description: Standard operating procedures for S-band and X-band polarimetric radars, hydrometeor classification, severe storm tracking, and automated nowcasting protocols.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Magnetron vs Klystron Power Output & Noise Calibration
Lesson 1.2: Antenna Pointing Verification via Sun-Tracking Routines

quiz.title: Doppler Weather Radar (DWR) Calibration Certification Examination

questions.question: Which dual-polarization radar parameter is the primary discriminant between large tumbling hail and heavy rain?
questions.explanation: Tumbling hailstones appear spherical on average with ZDR near 0 dB despite very high reflectivity (Z > 55 dBZ).

questions.question: What is the standard Nyquist velocity interval limit before Doppler velocity aliasing occurs?
questions.explanation: The maximum unambiguous Doppler velocity is given by Vmax = (wavelength * PRF) / 4.

questions.question: A sharp drop in Correlation Coefficient (RhoHV < 0.80) coincident with a hook echo reflectivity signifies:
questions.explanation: Chaotic, non-meteorological debris lofted by a tornado produces a distinct low RhoHV signature.

courses.title: Tropical Cyclone Track Prediction & Dvorak Satellite Intensity Analysis
courses.description: Satellite pattern recognition for North Indian Ocean cyclones (Arabian Sea & Bay of Bengal), curved band analysis, central dense overcast (CDO), and automated track warning dissemination.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Curved Band Logarithmic Spiral Fitting

quiz.title: Tropical Cyclone Warning & Dvorak Competency Test

questions.question: In the Enhanced Infrared (EIR) Dvorak technique, what does a warm spot enclosed within a cold ring indicate?
questions.explanation: The temperature difference between the warm eye and surrounding cold convective cloud tops determines the T-number.

courses.title: Autonomous Argo Profiling Float Telemetry & Real-Time Quality Control (RTQC)
courses.description: Complete operational handbook on 2,000m profiling Argo floats, hydraulic buoyancy engines, Iridium SBD telemetry, and INCOIS Real-Time Quality Control (RTQC) flags.

modules.title: Module 1: Hydraulic Buoyancy Engine & Profiling Cycle

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Descent to 1,000m Drift & 2,000m Deep Profile

questions.question: What is the standard parking depth of core Argo floats in the Indian Ocean?
questions.explanation: Standard core Argo floats drift at 1,000 meters for 9 days before dipping to 2,000 meters for ascent.

questions.question: Under IOC/WMO Argo data management guidelines, which QC flag represents verified 'Good Data'?
questions.explanation: QC Flag 1 indicates verified Good Data suitable for operational ocean assimilation.

courses.title: Indian Ocean Tsunami Early Warning System (ITEWS) & Coastal Inundation Modeling
courses.description: Seismic moment tensor estimation, Boussinesq tsunami propagation modeling, coastal BPR (Bottom Pressure Recorder) data assimilation, and SOPs for coastal community alerts.

modules.title: Module 1: Subduction Zone Ruptures & Propagation Models

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Makran & Sunda Trench Tsunami Dynamics

questions.question: What is the primary ocean sensor deployed by INCOIS to detect open-ocean tsunami waves in real time?
questions.explanation: BPR units deployed on the seafloor measure minute sea-surface height changes caused by passing tsunami waves.

courses.title: Earth System Modeling (IITM-ESM) & Decadal Climate Change Projections
courses.description: Physical parameterization of ocean-atmosphere-land-cryosphere couplings in the IITM Earth System Model, CMIP6 simulations, and Indian monsoon projections under IPCC warming scenarios.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Coupling GFS Atmospheric Model with MOM4 Ocean Core

questions.question: Which ocean model component is coupled in the IITM Earth System Model (IITM-ESM)?
questions.explanation: IITM-ESM couples the NCEP GFS atmospheric model with GFDL's Modular Ocean Model (MOM4).

courses.title: Slurm Workload Scheduling & MPI Parallel Scaling on 18 PFLOPS HPC
courses.description: Optimizing massively parallel weather prediction jobs on Mihir & Pratyush supercomputer clusters, Slurm CPU affinity, Infiniband topologies, and unified model compilation.

modules.title: Module 1: Slurm Batch Scripting & CPU Affinity

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Slurm Node Topology & sbatch Directives

questions.question: Which Slurm directive sets the total number of MPI tasks required for a distributed NWP model run?
questions.explanation: #SBATCH --ntasks specifies the exact count of MPI parallel processes to be spawned.

questions.question: In Slurm job states, what does 'PD' indicate?
questions.explanation: 'PD' stands for Pending in Slurm scheduler queue.

courses.title: Deep Ocean Mission: Matsya-6000 Manned Submersible Safety & Engineering
courses.description: Manned deep ocean exploration at 6,000m depths: titanium pressure hull, life support systems, acoustic positioning (USBL), and subsea robotics protocols.

modules.title: Module 1: Titanium Hull & 600 Bar Pressure Dynamics

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Ti-6Al-4V ELI Spherical Hull Stress Engineering

questions.question: What hydrostatic pressure must the Matsya-6000 titanium sphere withstand at 6,000m depth?
questions.explanation: At 6,000m depth, seawater exerts approximately 600 times atmospheric pressure (600 bar / 60 MPa).

questions.question: What material is utilized for the 2.1m diameter spherical pressure hull of Matsya-6000?
questions.explanation: Extra Low Interstitial (ELI) Titanium alloy Ti-6Al-4V offers high strength-to-weight and fracture toughness.

courses.title: Antarctic Station Operations (Maitri & Bharati) & Cold Weather Survival Protocols
courses.description: Pre-deployment training for Indian Scientific Expeditions to Antarctica and Arctic (Himadri): crevasse safety, extreme cold medicine, waste management under Madrid Protocol, and station micro-grid power.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Bharati Station Architecture & Environmental Standards

questions.question: What is India's permanent research base in Antarctica located at Larsemann Hills?
questions.explanation: Bharati Station (commissioned 2012) is located at Larsemann Hills, East Antarctica.

questions.question: Under the Antarctic Treaty Environmental Protocol (Madrid Protocol), all solid waste generated must be:
options: Packed and shipped back to the Indian mainland
questions.explanation: Zero waste discharge is enforced; all waste is compacted, treated, and returned to mainland ports.

discussions.title: Handling ground clutter attenuation during heavy cyclonic precipitation
discussions.content: During landfall of severe cyclone in coastal Odisha, Doppler velocity de-aliasing experienced fold errors. Has anyone tested the dual-PRF ratio 3:2 vs 4:3?
